harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed httpd on node1, deployed an inventory application at /var/www/inventory (correctly labeled httpd_sys_content_t), configured Apache to listen on TCP 8181 via /etc/httpd/conf.d/inventory.conf, added the SELinux port label (semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181) so enforcing mode permits the bind, opened firewalld for 8181, and enabled+started httpd. Verified the app serves over 8181 with SELinux enforcing and zero AVC denials. Completed the mandatory single-node (node1) restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified enforcing mode, httpd active, port 8181 listening, and HTTP 200 content after reboot.
actions_performed: Checked baseline SELinux mode (Enforcing) on node1
Searched for existing inventory app/web server - none found
Installed httpd + policycoreutils-python-utils via dnf
Created /var/www/inventory/index.html inventory content (auto-labeled httpd_sys_content_t)
Created /etc/httpd/conf.d/inventory.conf with Listen 8181 and VirtualHost
Ran semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181 to allow httpd_t to bind port 8181 under SELinux
Enabled and started httpd; confirmed listening on 8181
Verified HTTP 200 response with inventory content via curl to $NODE_IP:8181
Confirmed SELinux still Enforcing and no AVC denials
Opened firewalld port 8181/tcp permanently and reloaded
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline
Issued shutdown -r now on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming boot_id changed (proof of actual restart)
Re-verified post-restart: SELinux Enforcing, httpd active, port 8181 listening, inventory content served HTTP 200, no AVC denials

evidence.requirement: Baseline: SELinux enforcing prior to any change
evidence.summary: getenforce/sestatus show SELinux Enforcing, targeted policy, before any modification

evidence.requirement: Inventory app installed and served on TCP 8181
evidence.summary: httpd installed, inventory content created with httpd_sys_content_t label, VirtualHost configured for port 8181, httpd enabled/active and listening on *:8181

evidence.requirement: SELinux stays enforcing while port 8181 is permitted (mandatory access control compliance)
evidence.summary: semanage port -m -t http_port_t -p tcp 8181 applied; post-change getenforce still Enforcing and no AVC denials while httpd served on 8181

evidence.requirement: Functional proof the inventory application serves over port 8181
evidence.summary: curl to $NODE_IP:8181 returns HTTP 200 with inventory table content (Widget SKU-001 etc.)
firewalld active; 8181/tcp opened permanently and reload confirmed via firewall-cmd --list-ports
Captured pre-restart boot_id 31b01b46-96de-4ded-a021-49887e7d4053 as stable OS-native boot marker

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now backgrounded/disowned; command returned 'reboot-issued' successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out while node was down, then exec succeeded again with new boot_id e946e365-4350-4993-bdf4-06c18220782b, differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services, data, SELinux mode
evidence.summary: After restart: getenforce Enforcing, httpd active, port 8181 listening, curl returns HTTP 200 with inventory content, no AVC denials
